svg.title: Priorities and executors
svg.desc: Four interrupt priority levels and thread mode. The pager and fault handlers are highest; deadline interrupts next; other peripherals; the real-time executor at level 3 runs the audio and card task; the main executor in thread mode runs UI, input, power, USB, Bluetooth and the watchdog.
svg.text: MemManage (the pager), BusFault, UsageFault: resident, bounded time
Deadline interrupts: timer, audio DMA, Bluetooth UART: wake tasks
Other peripherals: USB, SD, I2C, RTC, PMU, GPIO: short, wake tasks
RT executor: the audio task (card, stream ring, decoder, DSP,
PCM ring, the player, library building when idle)
Main executor (WFI when idle): UI, input, power, USB, Bluetooth,
health, watchdog (fed only while everything makes progress)
